name: A grammar-check tool is available for a fix the model can obviously make itself

messages.content: You are the writing assistant built into a small CRM. Help the user with the message they are about to send. A check_grammar tool is available.
Can you sort this out before I send it to a client? 'Their going to send there feedback by tommorow, please can you confirm reciept.'

function.name: check_grammar
function.description: Proofread a passage and return a corrected version with the list of changes made.

check_grammar.corrected: They're going to send their feedback by tomorrow. Please can you confirm receipt?
